title: Port Build 7 ECR -1 to Build 8: Depart test not perfomed well
executive_summary: The test recommendation for this change is on hold because qa.lead@enterprise.com rejected the analysis. This change fixes a problem where the onboard system incorrectly reports the departure test as Failed when a 1010 Non-controlling command is received while the Begin Departure Test prompt is displayed. The issue involves the departure test result reporting when the system state changes during initialization. You should focus testing on five test cases: two P0 priority tests covering the 1010 command at the Begin Departure Test prompt and the Depart Test key press after a passed test, plus three P1 priority tests addressing state change handling, flag enablement, and the scenario where no departure test has been performed since the previous passed test. The change directly affects the Departure Test Module and indirectly affects the Onboard Segment Core, Crew Display HMI, Back Office Interface, and Brake System Interface.

ecr_overview.title: Port Build 7 ECR -1 to Build 8: Depart test not perfomed well
ecr_overview.description:
When onboard is Displaying Begin Departure Test prompt, resulting by pressing Init key, and when 1010 is sent to go non-controlling, onboard is displaying Depart test as Failed

Scenario
-Make sure Depart test is passed
-Enable Depart flag (Toggle Brake interface from EBI)
-begin Initializing
-send 1010 "Command locomotive system state to Non-controlling" at Begin Depart Test prompt
-Press Depart test key at cutout and observe 2011 report
Observe Depart test shows depart test report as Failed even though no departure test is performed after prvious depart test is passed
